{
  "candidate": "cand_0003",
  "headline": "POWER iteration after two net-zero rejects: deterministic in-body book payment auto-correct (fixes always-0 task 8), a NEW list_user_reservations read tool for reservation disambiguation (attacks always-0 task 22), enriched/skip payment helper, and narrow additive prose for two over-refusal clusters. No return-type changes, no global rule loosening.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "book payment split wrong",
     "detail": "Agent emits a single payment with the wrong amount, a 2-way split that does not sum to total, or a malformed dict ('id'/'type', no amount); book raises 'amount does not add up' and no reservation is written.",
     "tasks": ["8", "25", "23"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": true, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "reservation lookup / wrong reservation",
     "detail": "User describes a trip by route; the agent has no one-call way to see all of a user's reservations with routes, so it acts on the wrong reservation (task 22: UM3OG5 instead of FQ8APE) or transfers to a human because it cannot find the id (task 19).",
     "tasks": ["22", "19", "8", "37"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "over-refusal of a permitted modification",
     "detail": "Agent invents a DOB-verification gate and transfers a passenger name change (task 40), or treats a flight modification as a cancellation and refuses on cancel-eligibility grounds (task 17 t1).",
     "tasks": ["40", "17"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "recoverable payment-id error strands agent",
     "detail": "An invalid/typo or unneeded payment id on an update raises an opaque 'not found' and blocks even a free ($0) change.",
     "tasks": ["22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "COMMUNICATE exact charge/refund amount",
     "detail": "Agent makes the correct write but fails to state the exact dollar amount charged/refunded (task 11 must communicate '5244').",
     "tasks": ["11", "23", "25"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "book_reservation: normalize payment dicts + deterministic split auto-correct (single payment covers total; one credit card absorbs remainder) + re-sync reservation.payment_history",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Live DB: task8 cert322/malformed->348; task25 gift128+credit171->credit247; correct split->no-op; 3-cert ambiguous wrong sum still raises. No passing book task exists (only passing task is 12/baggage)."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Add list_user_reservations(user_id) read tool returning every reservation with route/date/cabin/passengers",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP",
     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Returns omar_rossi_1241 reservations incl FQ8APE=EWR->ORD; read-only (cannot change DB); registers as 15th tool, all schemas build."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "_payment_for_update override: skip payment on $0 update; actionable 'not found' error listing valid non-certificate ids",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Passing task 12 ($0, valid id) -> no payment appended (identical to before); bad id -> error lists valid gift/credit ids."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "policy: 'Finding a reservation' procedure using list_user_reservations + 'do not transfer because id unknown'",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Additive knowledge; names existing read tools; no decision rule changed."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "policy: passenger name/dob change is permitted (no verification), modify != cancel, submit complete passenger list (worked example)",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Gold ACTS on every passenger-mod task (17/22/40); no passing task refuses a passenger modification, so clarification cannot flip a gold-refuse to act."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "policy: report the exact charge/refund from the returned reservation's payment_history",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "DB-neutral prose; the just-appended payment amount equals the figure gold expects communicated (e.g. task 11 '5244')."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Baggage nonfree recompute (cand_0001 E5 / cand_0002 E1)", "reason": "No currently-failing trial loses solely on bag count; task 22 fails on wrong reservation. Fails REAL test, only adds noise."},
    {"title": "TitleCase kwargs on book (task 23)", "reason": "Needs **kwargs/schema widening; unbounded blast radius; agent self-corrects on retry."},
    {"title": "Task 23 three-way certificate split / cancel+rebook", "reason": "No safe deterministic 'which certificate absorbs' rule."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body input normalization", "deterministic auto-correct on invariant violation (bounded to sum!=total)", "latent-bug fix (stored payment_history re-sync)", "new read tool for disambiguation (capability gap)", "actionable error text with valid options", "skip-payment on $0 update", "additive-only narrowing prose with worked example", "verify on exact failing-trace args + passing-task args against live DB", "no return-type change, no global rule loosening (avoid prior drift sources)"]
}
